purpose: Communicates important contextual information inline on a page.

notes: Provider language localizes the built-in dismiss label.

useWhen: A persistent contextual status or warning belongs near related content.
A dynamically inserted message must be announced.

avoidWhen.situation: The message is brief, temporary, and global.

supportedInteractions: Dismiss in controlled or uncontrolled visibility mode.
approvedPatterns: Compose title, description, actions, and an optional close button.
Choose layout default, stacked, or compact for action arrangement.
Choose appearance light or highContrast for emphasis.
On highContrast, use secondary fill and ghost Buttons with highContrast (Alert.Actions and Alert.CloseButton apply it to direct Veli Buttons).
Use alert live behavior only for dynamically inserted or updated messages.
Use status live behavior for always-visible banners.
limitations: The close button only dismisses through its enclosing Alert.
Default layout keeps actions on one row; use layout stacked when actions should wrap.
accessibility: Choose alert or status live behavior based on message timing.
Keep visible text sufficient without relying on intent color or icon.
Override the localized dismiss label when additional context is needed.
responsive: Use layout stacked when actions need to wrap on narrow widths.
rtl: The close button uses logical end positioning.
Provider language supplies the Dhivehi dismiss label.
